webhooks.detail: Team webhooks (up to 20 per team, Pro/Enterprise) for deployment, project, env var, feature flag, firewall events; JSON POST payload. Integration webhooks for billing events.

evidence.quote: A webhook is a trigger-based HTTP endpoint configured to receive HTTP POST requests through events.

sandbox.detail: Free Hobby plan (no billing cycles, 100 deployments/day, 200 projects) usable to test integrations via API token. No separate sandbox/test mode.

evidence.quote: The Hobby plan is **free** and includes a generous set of features on a **per month** basis:

rate_limits.summary: Per-action hard limits by plan, e.g. deployments/day Free 100, Pro 6000, Enterprise 24000; deploy hooks 60/hour/project

evidence.quote: Rate limits are hard limits that apply to the platform when performing actions that require a response from our API.
The @vercel/sdk is a type-safe Typescript SDK that allows you to access the resources and methods of the Vercel REST API.
